summary: Residential west kerb with parked cars; homes about 15-25 m away on this side.

best_section.where: West kerb of Brisbane Street, midway down, beside the overgrown lot and apartment block

drivers.seclusion: Overgrown vegetation and a driveway side on the west; the Madison terrace sits 9 m away just south of the section and a detached home sits 9 m north of it. Apartments across the road are 22 m or more away.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with cars parked on the west edge, so room to stop.
drivers.traffic: Quiet side street; a busy road at the north end.
drivers.convention: Cars park here, though 2P resident-permit signs apply Mon-Fri 7am-6pm.

flags: Max grade 11.2% at the north end; about 1% along best section
Signs: 2P Mon-Fri 7am-6pm and no stopping 4-6:30pm near the Sir Fred Schonell Drive end
Gate 219 m away has a way round
sun_shade: Trees along the west verge shade it from the west; open to the morning sun from the east.
